note: `after_contact`, applied in `lean_drift`, gives the second-order identity at 0 for log det(K+Gm) - log det K, with tr(K^-1 Gm) and the squared trace term. The full expansion with O(|v|^3) remainder and coefficients 1/2, -1/4 is not stated.

snippet.text:
lemma after_contact (h : Memo P 0) (he : Memo Q 0) (hp : (P 0).det≠0) (hy : Q 0=0) (u v) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun y => Real.log ((P+Q) y).det) 0 ![u,v] =
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun y => Real.log (P y).det) 0 ![u,v] + iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (fun y => ((P y)⁻¹ * Q y).trace) 0 ![u,v] -
      ((P 0)⁻¹ * directionM Q 0 u * (P 0)⁻¹ * directionM Q 0 v).trace := by

proof_context.conclusion: For P, Q analytic with det P(0) nonzero and Q(0) = 0, the Hessian at 0 of log det(P+Q) equals that of log det P plus the Hessian of tr(P^-1 Q) minus tr(P(0)^-1 Q'(u) P(0)^-1 Q'(v)).
